content.short: HyperPlay is a Web3-native game launcher and store where players carry their crypto wallets, tokens, and NFTs into every game they play.
content.description: HyperPlay is a desktop game launcher built natively for Web3, enabling players to bring their crypto wallets, tokens, and NFTs seamlessly into any game on the platform. Unlike traditional launchers, HyperPlay aggregates games from the Epic Games Store, GOG, and Web3-native publishers into a single interface. The platform is designed to become the primary distribution layer for blockchain-enabled games, supporting multiple networks including Mantle and removing the friction between game ownership and on-chain assets.
content.meta: HyperPlay is a Web3-native game store letting players bring wallets and NFTs into every game on Mantle. Discover HyperPlay on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
